content_blocks.text: Pathogenicity ofHelicobacterspp. in dogs and cats is unclear; therefore, there are no generally accepted guidelines for treatment of HLO infections in dogs and cats.
Currently there is no indication for treating asymptomatic infected animals.
Eradication of gastric HLO should only be considered in infected dogs and cats that have compatible clinical signs that cannot be attributed to another disease process.
